title: Page to Audio — Chrome Extension
description: A Chromium browser extension that extracts content from the current webpage, processes it with an OpenAI model, and generates audio. Designed around a lightweight browser action, content script and background service worker.
features: Extract page content from the active browser tab
Process selected page text using an OpenAI API integration
Generate audio output based on page content
workflow: Content script extracts readable page data
Background service worker coordinates API requests
Popup and overlay provide page-level interaction
